window.note: Window starts at the 08:04 Oct 4 start of the original morning pull and runs to this re-run (about 38 hours) so the already-pulled call run file and the full business day of Oct 5 are both covered. Stage, tag and status values are live at re-run time.

run_notes: Re-run on 2026-10-05 evening via the read-only REST client (scripts/ghl_client.py GhlClient, GET only) because the mcp__ghl__* tools were not attached; endpoints and API versions used: /contacts/ and /opportunities/search and /calendars/events (2021-07-28), /conversations/search, /conversations/{id}/messages (2021-04-15), /opportunities/pipelines, /locations/{id}/customFields. No endpoint or scope failed.

Opportunity notes came from /opportunities/search with getNotes=true; the GHL API names that parameter differently from the MCP flag but returned notes.notes[] as expected. Contact-level notes and tasks were not needed and not pulled.

calls.error: scripts/ghl_calls_pull.py ran at 08:04 on Oct 5, so its run file covers Oct 4 08:04 to Oct 5 08:04 only. 41 further call messages after that point (Oct 5 morning to evening) are not in the run file and have no call record here; their machine-written summaries in each thread were used only as thread context.
